row.title: FLOW-BALANCE-1: issue inflow never exceeds closures
row.body: foundation/balance.py, run in every fleet queue pass, measures net issue inflow vs closures per day/week and SLA age; when tipped it supersedes duplicates, batches family floods into BATCH-* items, throttles filers via admit(), boosts the executor daily cap and files Q-BALANCE-flow. Superseded never counts as a closure. Twins: seed scripts/balance.py, workers core/flowbalance. Page /balance.
